A rabbi says Allah will hold all creation on His fingers, and the Prophet smiles agreement; Allah will grasp the earth, roll up the heavens and say: I am King.
Allah says the son of Adam hurts Him by abusing Time, though He is Time, all things are in His Hands, and He turns the night and day.
Allah said the son of Adam hurts Him by abusing Time, for He is Time: all things are in His Hands and He alternates night and day.
